description: The events of a month (2020–2035): new and full moons and quarters with their signs, the Sun and planets entering signs, retrograde stations and all retrograde periods touching the month, solar and lunar eclipses with their visibility from Warsaw; optionally every Moon sign change. Times in a time zone (Polish time by default).

lang.description: Language of the names in the answer: pl (default) or en

month.description: YYYY-MM; leave out for this month

moon_signs.description: Also list each time the Moon enters a sign (about 12 a month)

tz.description: IANA time zone of the times (default Europe/Warsaw)

name: astro_calendar
title: Astrological calendar of a month
